meta.name: setup
meta.description: Run initial NanoClaw setup. Use when user wants to install NanoClaw, configure it, or go through first-time setup. Triggers on "setup", "install", "configure nanoclaw", or first-time setup requests.

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw 的首次安装与配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接触 NanoClaw 需要初始化设置
copy.tagline_en: Complete initial setup and configuration of NanoClaw
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are new to NanoClaw and need to initialize it

howto.what: 用户要求安装或设置NanoClaw时，Claude会指示用户在终端运行bash nanoclaw.sh，该脚本自动处理依赖安装、容器镜像、凭据配置、服务启动、首个agent创建及可选频道接入。若中途出错，脚本会调用Claude辅助恢复并从断点继续。
howto.when: 当用户想安装或配置NanoClaw、进行首次设置时触发；触发词包括“setup”“install”“configure nanoclaw”等。

say.note: Claude会指导你执行初始化脚本
Claude会引导你完成首次设置

howto.what_en: When the user asks to install or set up NanoClaw, Claude tells them to run `bash nanoclaw.sh` in the terminal. The script handles dependencies, container image, credentials, service, first agent, and optional channel wiring. On errors, it offers Claude-assisted recovery and resumes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to install or configure NanoClaw or go through first-time setup, including keywords like 'setup', 'install', 'configure nanoclaw'.

say_en.note: Claude will tell you to run bash nanoclaw.sh
Claude will guide you through the setup script
Claude will walk you through first-time setup
